title: Translation
description: The ribosome reads the message three letters at a time and strings the amino acids together: the genetic code. Unlocks cheap Engineered Enzymes and a new Synthetic Cell route.

puzzle.goal: A ribosome gets each of L codons wrong with chance ε. Write the share Y of chains with no mistake at all.
puzzle.name: Error-free chains
puzzle.ask: Find Y for ε = @{ε} and L = @{L}.
puzzle.method: Each codon is right with chance 1 − ε, independently, so all L are right with chance (1 − ε)^L ≈ e^(−εL).
